newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stock market closed for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stock market closed for holiday.

text.p: The Jakarta stock market was closed on Friday for the Moslem Eid al-Adha festival. The market will reopen on Monday.
On Thursday, the Jakarta composite index rose 4.78 points, or 0.75 percent, to close at 637.59 points. Advancers led decliners by 112 to 76 with 92 issues unchanged.
Total turn-over was estimated at around 259 billion rupiah compared with 502 billion rupiah on Wednesday.
